summary: Postal is a self-hosted mail server (Rails/MariaDB/Mysql2): org and user admin CRUD, per-server SMTP/HTTP/address endpoints and routes, credentials and webhooks, plus a per-server message database (MariaDB) storing messages, deliveries, clicks, loads, links, suppressions and raw bodies; an SMTP/HTTP/HTTP-API send pipeline and a queued-message delivery worker write and read that state. Full write path: db/migrations + app/models/* + app/controllers/* + app/lib/message_dequeuer/* + app/senders/*; read path: messages_controller + legacy API + message_db.
